We are Apex Resins. We manufacture industrial adhesives and sealants. Our accounting and invoicing are perfectly handled in Tally. Our massive bottleneck is batch traceability and expiry tracking. We sell chemical drums with strict 6-month shelf lives, but we manage batch numbers in Excel. If a customer reports a defective adhesive, we have no way to trace which raw material batch caused it, or which other customers received the same bad batch. We need strict compliance and traceability.
